item.title: Mesu Nie Gari ~Ingyaku no Arcade-gai
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Rave’N
  • 発売日: 2016-02-26
  • スコア: 5.83/10 (32 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 牝贄狩～淫虐のアーケード街
  • 英語名: Mesu Nie Gari ~Ingyaku no Arcade-gai

あらすじ

The main character runs a security company in a certain local city.

His hobby, and his main job, is to sell the abducted women to those who are interested in them.

The place where the women are hunted is a mall in the corner of a busy downtown area.

There, there will always be a lot of people, and it doesn’t matter who disappears.
